share: within the competition window (40 to 90 seconds after shaping), video payload rate of the main call / (that rate + competitor goodput)
competitor_kbps: for TCP, bytes per second at the receiver; for the GCC call, the payload rate of its main video stream
win_*: readings of the main call within the competition window
vmaf_window: mean VMAF of frames within the competition window (located with the complete per-frame timestamps of the decoded file)
recovery_s: seconds, after the competitor leaves at 90 s, until the 5 s moving average is back at 90% of its mean over 20 to 30 s
share_valid: validity gate of the share endpoint (comp_metrics in this script)
the rest: As in the data dictionary of hd720-closedloop-v1
